ios.desc:
A space for thinkers to hang out, a moderated, paid-only, ad-free social network designed for insightful connections and real conversations.

How we keep the network authentic:

Loops: Only our vetted "Kornerstones" can post content (Loops), so your feed stays high-signal and meaningful. 

Nooks: These are our on demand 9-person video chat room. Just real people having real conversations.

Tip: Keep notifications on! You'll get one when someone joins a Nook.

Your Apple subscription includes a 7-day free trial. You won’t be charged until the week is up, giving you full access to explore the network for free to see if it’s for you.

Terms of Use (EULA): [https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/)
